programmes.d: When Ovide purchased his 1957 Bel Air sight unseen, the car was a rusted piece of junk so it’s on Dan to figure out how to restore this classic. Dino loves to go fast. His 1969 Super Bee is anything but super. Dan is tasked to feed Dino’s need for speed.
The underdog Golf R takes on the mighty Audi RS3. Then, test the M3's drift analyser.
Does this Toyota hot hatch live up to the hype? Then, take to the ice with a Yaris.
How does this fabulous M3 fare with power to all four wheels? Then, can this Lamborghini beat the McLaren P1?
Witness a supercar that Gordon Murray's had in his head for 25 years. Then, take a Cayman GT4 RS for a spin.
Put the last combustion-powered Lotus through its paces. Then, find out if the Ferrari 296 GTB thrills.
Join Adam Towler in adrenaline-pumping trips inside Subaru rally cars.
Is this generation of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS the ultimate track and road car? Then, test the McLaren 765LT.
Test the Ford GT, Porsche 911 GT2 RS, AMG GT R and Lotus Exige Cup 430 at the Anglesey Coastal Circuit.
Embark on a road trip across Europe to uncover the soul of this 912-bhp Audi.
Take a final spin with the Nissan GT-R NISMO. Then, witness a true test among analogue supercars.
The AWD shootout continues as evo decides whether AWD limits performance or takes cars to new heights!
Part 1 of the AWD test pits seven cars in a showdown at Anglesey Circuit!
Discover the Ferrari 296 Speciale! Then, Meaden races a Lotus Cortina in the fierce E2TC series!
Dive into the Porsche 911 R! Then, the 918 Spyder stuns with hybrid tech and thrilling performance!
Explore the Porsche 991! Then, see how Shell V-Power cleans engines and boosts performance!
The Ferrari Purosangue shines with V12 power and agility. Then, the Subaru BRZ takes an epic road trip!
The Manthey GT3 RS pushes extremes as one of the wildest 911s ever, offering near-Cup car performance!
Meaden tests the new Ferrari F80 in Italy! Then, dive into the legendary Skyline GT-R R32!
Discover the Pagani Huayra's craftsmanship! Then, the Mégane 265 Cup goes against the SEAT León Cupra 280!
Catchpole shares a night drive in the Bentley GT Speed! Then, hit the track with the RS 6 Avant and VXR8!
Watch the BMW M3 battle the AMG C 63 S on track! Then, Catchpole recalls a McLaren road trip through Morocco!
Check out the Alpine A110's lightweight thrills. Then, dive into the Focus RS with its AWD punch!
Experience RM Sotheby's Ferrari auctions! Then, evo hits the 2013 Frankfurt show for standout cars!
Catchpole showcases the Rolls-Royce Wraith's elegance and power! Then, witness the wild, amphibious Scamander!
Meaden attempts a world record! Then, witness the M5 on a frozen lake and a drive in the LFA!
The judges debate all nine cars and ultimately crown evo Car of the Year for 2024!
Five judges push nine cars across road and track to reveal each model's character!
Danny has a last-minute change of heart and can't let go of a classic car he promised to sell to a loyal customer.
The shop has its hands full with a custom psychedelic bike, and Danny's infamous friend.

Kevin's brother is a judge, but that won't get him a free ride, and the guys struggle to finish his '62 Chevy pick-up within budget. Later, Scott spots an incredibly rare Corvette, but will he screw up the deal without Danny's help?
The shop agrees to build a brave father a hot rod wheelchair, and Danny gets stuck in a bind when a pink car project doesn't go as planned.

Chumlee from Gold & Silver stops by to pick up his custom 1963 Lincoln, but gets some really bad news instead. Later a casino VIP commissions a bike inspired by the largest chunk of gold in the world.

Emotions run deep when Danny receives an astronomical offer for one of his prized cars. Kevin helps spot an epic flip that brings in a ton of cash and the guys visit SEMA, the world's biggest and most extravagant auto show.

Kevin is won over by a hotrod pick-up truck, Danny tracks down a customer's original 1969 Firebird but its terrible condition may make it impossible to restore, and an unannounced visitor causes drama at the shop.
Danny finds a rare 1960 delivery vehicle to show off at the Viva Vegas car show, and after Mike gets in trouble at work, the guys decide to build Danny a customized coffin couch.

Last year, Count's Kustoms helped Shane surprise his fiance Tanya with a customized classic pick-up truck. This year she's returning the favor, but will the shop be able to return Shane's prized 1970 Mustang to its former glory.
Danny and the boys give away a perfect hot rod at the annual Rockabilly Reunion at Lake Havasu. Later, a lady biker stuns the boys with a custom order for the bike of her dreams.
Count's Kustoms speeds to the rescue after Kevin's son encounters trouble on the race track. Danny stumbles upon an extremely rare 1979 Dodge Dreamer.
Danny conspires with a proud dad to give the ultimate surprise 16th birthday gift, and the shop frustrates a customer with a design error on a scaled-down commemorative Model T Firetruck.

Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

Robby wants to convert a 1926 Ford Model T to a far rarer 1914 C Cab. Dan agrees to the plan, but soon has cause to regret it. Anthony buys a 69 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible, but the car of his dreams is an accident waiting to happen.

Dennis has always dreamed of owning the bright orange 1970 Shelby GT500 that kicked his ass in a drag race. Returning customer Rikk wants to get his rare 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst in shape. But the car is plagued by a mystifying list of gremlins.

Ben wants a partial restoration for his father’s 1962 Maserati, but Dan sees only one solution – turning this heirloom into one of the rarest survivor cars on earth. Raymond and Diane only want one thing for their worn out 1966 bug – perfection.

Nick challenges Dan to build a 1969 Camaro Pace Car that can beat the fastest Chevelle that FantomWorks has ever built. Pete’s Mustang Convertible was in three different shops, but it arrives with far more problems than anyone was expecting.

Dan agrees to fix a 1947 Mack Firetruck that take FantomWorks into wet and uncharted territory. Ken’s 1971 Malibu Chevelle arrives as a garage ornament that hasn't run in five years, so it’s up to FantomWorks to bring this family heirloom back to life.

FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.
